description: Use this when the user asks how well a site or metro is connected by fiber, e.g. "is this parcel fiber-ready?", "how many carriers can serve it?" or "internet exchanges near Ashburn". Pass lat and lon for a point read (near-net distance bucket, nearest carrier distance, carrier data coverage) or market for the metro profile (carriers and dark-fiber availability zones). include peering adds nearby exchange and network density for a point. If carrier_data_coverage is none_in_region, nothing was measured there; that is not the same as no fiber.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, for example 39.04

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, for example -77.48

market.description: Market name for the metro profile, for example "Dallas-Fort Worth"

radius_km.description: Search radius for the point read in km, for example 50

name: fiber_connectivity
title: Fiber and peering connectivity
